newsitem.title: USA: Odwalla shrs off on news of tainted juice.
newsitem.headline: Odwalla shrs off on news of tainted juice.

text.p: Odwalla Inc shares slumped 24 percent Thursday morning after an outbreak of bacterial food poisoning in the Seattle area was traced by health officials to unpasteurized Odwalla fruit juice.
The shares lost 4-3/8 to 14 after hitting a year-low of 11.

Odwalla, a rapidly growing fresh juice and beverage company based in Half Moon Bay, Calif., on Wednesday issued a natiowide recall of products containing fresh apple juice, and many retailers pulled Odwalla beverages from their shevles.

Washington State and county health officials Wednesday said 10 of the 13 confirmed cases of E. coli food poisoning had been conclusively traced to Odwalla juice and the remaining three cases were under investigation.
Hambrecht & Quist downgraded the stock to hold from buy, saying publicity surrounding the recall could hurt sales.
